mass_source: Assumed: 1000 kg empty, no occupants. The sources used give no weight for the 7A.

steering_servo.note: Acts at the sector shaft; with the 12:1 box, 80 N m there is 6.7 N m at the steering wheel.

suspension.note: Front: 28 kN/m at the wheel through the 0.40 m arm (4480 N m/rad of torsion-bar twist), with damping at about 0.3 of critical (1.65 kN s/m at the wheel). Rear: 38 kN/m at the axle through the 0.55 m trailing arms (11.5 kN m/rad), damping 2.07 kN s/m at the axle; roll 16 kN m/rad. Preloads are calibrated at run time to the design ride height. The front-heavy car (engine and gearbox over the front wheels) sits about 60% on the front tyres.

tire.note: Low-pressure straight-side tyres: the shared compliant contact, round crown 65 mm half-width.

assumptions: Mass, mass split, centre of mass, inertia, spring rates and damping are estimates.
